owner_request:
# Owner request — synthetic forward pilot

Plan the verification of an axial bar calculation before we reuse any reasoning
for a lifting-bucket study. A narrower worker needs useful reproducible next work.
The bar is 1.2 m long with uniform area 240 mm², E = 70 GPa, fixed at the left,
and has a 3.5 kN tensile load at the right. Use linear small-strain axial behavior;
there are no other loads. Right is positive. Keep the original mixed units visible.

We have no solver model or numerical results, bucket geometry, weld details,
material certificate, load spectrum or applicable design standard. Do not invent
engineering acceptance or transfer the bar's qualification to a bucket. Still do
the useful reference work that is possible. Available tools: Python arithmetic
and text; no FE solver or browser. Actual worker model/configuration unknown.
Owner authorizes only local drafting and computation, not release or external writes.
purpose: Prepare a reproducible axial-bar verification reference before any lifting-bucket reuse; preserve the engineering evidence gaps.

knowledge.reason: For 0≤x≤L, dN/dx=0, N(L)=F and u(0)=0 give N=F, sigma=F/A, epsilon=F/(EA), u(x)=Fx/(EA), R=-F, k=EA/L and U=F*u(L)/2=N²L/(2EA). Internal tension is positive; R is the support force on the bar.
Use N-mm: L=1200 mm, A=240 mm², E=70000 N/mm², F=+3500 N. Independently use SI: L=1.2 m, A=240e-6 m², E=70e9 N/m², F=+3500 N; compare after converting outputs.
